question: Is the global margin gate failing because margin scale and low-margin exact precision differ materially between the eight already-frozen reasoning classes?
hypothesis: Replay the exact negative R3 representation, repaired relation, eight fixed 64-motif classes, pooled training-median threshold, and heldout population without changing any gate or capacity. For attribution only, compute the training margin median within each fixed top-1 reasoning class and repaired exact precision below the unchanged global threshold within each class. Among classes with at least 25 below-threshold heldout rows, the precision range will be at least 0.15, and the range of the eight class training-margin medians will be at least 0.05. All 19 same-class hidden gains will reproduce below the unchanged global threshold. This would support fixed-class calibration as the next bounded readout factor.
